knobs.note: BH-6876: a Harness CI test shard job ("Tests, traced (shard ...") still in progress this many minutes after it started is ONE critical page (ci-shard-slow:<repo>). The job's timeout is 45 minutes, so the line sits below it. A value that is not a positive integer falls back to 35.

BH-6876: at most this many in-progress harness-ci.yml runs have their jobs read per tick, oldest first. The rest are deferred, and a tick with a deferred run never resolves the page. GitHub reads per tick: 1 + this.

BH-6876: the repo whose in-progress Harness CI (harness-ci.yml) runs are watched. NOT settable from the control plane: it is an identity the lane reads GitHub as, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.
